pages.text: Every fighter has a hidden $(l)pressure$() bar from 0 to 100. Landing hits fills the enemy's bar; taking hits fills yours.$(br2)Whenever a hit, block or break changes a bar, a red bar replaces your experience bar: $(4)your$() pressure on one side, your $(4)target's$() on the other. After four seconds without another change, the experience bar comes back.

Pressure slowly fades all the time, so an advantage has to be kept up. After about two seconds without new pressure it drains quickly: mobs fairly fast, players faster still, so a crowd can't pin you down forever.$(br2)Each hit you land also relieves some of your own pressure: attacking is the best defense.
